# OAuth Consent Handler Server Action Analysis

## Overview
This is a Next.js server action that processes OAuth consent flows. It handles user approval/denial and generates authorization codes.

## Key Functionality

**Consent Processing:**
The handler accepts form data containing OAuth parameters like `client_id`, `redirect_uri`, `state`, and `scope`. When users deny consent, the system redirects with an "access_denied" error.

**User Verification:**
The code retrieves the authenticated user via Supabase. If no user exists, it redirects to the login page.

**Application Validation:**
An RPC call validates the client application exists: `"get_application_by_client_id"`. If validation fails, an invalid_client error is returned.

**Authorization Code Generation:**
The system creates a random 32-character code with an expiration timestamp, storing it via the `"create_authorization_code"` RPC with PKCE challenge parameters.

## Security Considerations

- Uses PKCE flow support (code_challenge/code_challenge_method)
- Validates redirect URIs against registered applications
- Captures user consent in the database
- Includes comprehensive error handling with OAuth-compliant error responses
- Special handling for Next.js redirect exceptions

## Error Management
Errors redirect to the provided `redirect_uri` with standardized OAuth error codes (access_denied, invalid_client, server_error) and the original state parameter preserved.

title: "handleConsent (OAuth Consent Handler - stem-system)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_parse: formData.get(action, client_id, redirect_uri, state, code_challenge, code_challenge_method, scope)
    q_parse --> q_check_deny: evaluate action

    q_check_deny --> q_deny: action == deny
    q_check_deny --> q_auth: action != deny

    q_deny --> [*]: redirect(redirectWithError(redirect_uri, access_denied, state))

    q_auth --> q_get_user: supabase = createClient(); supabase.auth.getUser()
    q_get_user --> q_check_user: evaluate user result

    q_check_user --> q_no_user: user == null
    q_check_user --> q_validate_app: user exists

    q_no_user --> [*]: redirect(/login)

    q_validate_app --> q_rpc_app: supabase.rpc(get_application_by_client_id, client_id)
    q_rpc_app --> q_check_app: evaluate application result

    q_check_app --> q_invalid_app: application == null
    q_check_app --> q_record_consent: application exists

    q_invalid_app --> [*]: redirect(redirectWithError(redirect_uri, invalid_client, state))

    q_record_consent --> q_rpc_consent: supabase.rpc(create_user_consent, user_id, application_id, scope)
    q_rpc_consent --> q_gen_code: code = generateRandomString(32); expiresAt = getAuthCodeExpiry()
    q_gen_code --> q_rpc_code: supabase.rpc(create_authorization_code, code, application_id, user_id, redirect_uri, code_challenge, code_challenge_method, scope, expires_at)
    q_rpc_code --> q_check_code: evaluate codeError

    q_check_code --> q_code_error: codeError != null
    q_check_code --> q_build_url: codeError == null

    q_code_error --> [*]: redirect(redirectWithError(redirect_uri, server_error, state))

    q_build_url --> q_redirect: callbackUrl = new URL(redirect_uri); set code and state params
    q_redirect --> [*]: redirect(callbackUrl)

    note right of q_parse
        INV-001: All form parameters must be present (client_id, redirect_uri, state, scope)
        INV-002: redirect_uri must match registered application redirect URI
    end note

    note right of q_auth
        INV-003: User must be authenticated via Supabase session before consent processing
    end note

    note right of q_gen_code
        INV-004: Authorization code is cryptographically random, 32 characters
        INV-005: Authorization code has bounded expiry via getAuthCodeExpiry()
        INV-006: PKCE parameters (code_challenge, code_challenge_method) are persisted with authorization code
    end note

    note right of q_record_consent
        INV-007: User consent is recorded before authorization code generation
    end note

    note right of q_build_url
        INV-008: state parameter is preserved in redirect to prevent CSRF
    end note

---
title: "handleConsent error handler (OAuth Consent Handler - stem-system)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_catch: catch(e) from try block

    q_catch --> q_check_next_redirect: e instanceof Error and e.message == NEXT_REDIRECT
    q_check_next_redirect --> q_rethrow_msg: true
    q_check_next_redirect --> q_check_digest: false

    q_rethrow_msg --> [*]: throw e (re-throw Next.js redirect)

    q_check_digest --> q_rethrow_digest: typeof e == object and e != null and digest in e
    q_check_digest --> q_unexpected: no digest property

    q_rethrow_digest --> [*]: throw e (re-throw Next.js digest redirect)

    q_unexpected --> q_build_error: log error
    q_build_error --> [*]: redirect(redirectWithError(redirect_uri, server_error, state))

    note right of q_catch
        INV-009: Next.js redirect exceptions must be re-thrown, not swallowed
        INV-010: Unexpected errors must not leak internal details to client (only server_error code returned)
    end note

    note right of q_check_digest
        INV-011: Both redirect detection patterns (message check and digest check) must be evaluated to avoid swallowing redirects
    end note

content.content:
# Analysis of Supabase Client Configuration File

This TypeScript file exports two factory functions for creating Supabase clients in a Next.js server environment.

## Key Components

**createSupabaseClient()**: A private async function that instantiates either a standard or admin Supabase client. It retrieves cookies from Next.js headers and conditionally selects between the anonymous key and service role key based on the `isAdmin` parameter.

**createClient()**: Exports a public wrapper that creates a standard client with `isAdmin` set to false.

**createAdminClient()**: Exports a public wrapper using `createSupabaseJsClient` directly rather than the SSR variant. The implementation notes explain that the SSR approach causes "RLS that [gets] evaluated" with the authenticated role, resulting in silent failures for update/delete operations.

## Configuration Details

Both clients reference a database schema named `'member'` with explicit warnings (in English and Japanese) against modification. The standard client enables auto-refresh and session persistence, while the admin client disables these features to bypass row-level security constraints.

The file includes error handling for missing environment variables and attempts to manage cookie operations with fallback error catching for Server Components.

---
title: "createSupabaseClient (stem-system: src/lib/supabase/server.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_cookies: cookieStore = await cookies()
    q_cookies --> q_env: supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
    q_env --> q_key_select: evaluate isAdmin

    q_key_select --> q_admin_key: isAdmin == true
    q_key_select --> q_anon_key: isAdmin == false

    q_admin_key --> q_admin_check: supabaseKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
    q_anon_key --> q_build_client: supabaseKey = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY

    q_admin_check --> q_error_missing: !process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
    q_admin_check --> q_build_client: process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY exists

    q_error_missing --> [*]: throw Error SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY not defined

    q_build_client --> q_configure: createServerClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseKey, options)
    q_configure --> [*]: return client

    note right of q_key_select
        INV-001: isAdmin selects between service role key and anon key
        INV-002: schema is always 'member' regardless of isAdmin
    end note

    note right of q_build_client
        INV-003: autoRefreshToken and persistSession are disabled when isAdmin is true
        INV-004: detectSessionInUrl is always false
    end note

    note right of q_error_missing
        INV-005: admin client creation fails fast if SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is undefined
    end note

---
title: "createClient (stem-system: src/lib/supabase/server.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_call: createSupabaseClient(false)
    q_call --> [*]: return client

    note right of q_call
        INV-001: always creates non-admin client (isAdmin = false)
        INV-002: returned client uses NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
        INV-003: RLS is enforced on this client
    end note

---
title: "createAdminClient (stem-system: src/lib/supabase/server.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_check_env: check process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY

    q_check_env --> q_error: !process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
    q_check_env --> q_build: process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY exists

    q_error --> [*]: throw Error SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY not defined

    q_build --> q_configure: createSupabaseJsClient(url, serviceRoleKey, options)
    q_configure --> [*]: return adminClient

    note right of q_check_env
        INV-001: fails fast if service role key is missing
    end note

    note right of q_build
        INV-002: uses @supabase/supabase-js createClient, NOT SSR createServerClient
        INV-003: bypasses cookie-based auth to avoid RLS evaluated as authenticated role
        INV-004: autoRefreshToken and persistSession are both disabled
        INV-005: schema is always 'member'
    end note
